topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Rain's been falling hard, streets're slick as sin. Got a case of a kid, maybe not even out of his teens, accused of plagiarism. Digging into this, I'm telling you, the city's a cold, hard place. You don't get to wear your heart on your sleeve, not if you want to stay alive. This kid, he's got that lost look, like he's tumbled down the rabbit hole and ain't sure which way is up. I'm supposed to clear his name, prove he wrote what he said he did. Easy enough, right? But every lead's a dead end, every witness's eyes slide away when you start asking questions. Money's running thin, and time's a luxury I can't afford. I just hope this city doesn't swallow us both before I can figure out what really went down.
